d: The Senior Cloud Security Engineer will work closely with cloud, infrastructure, network, endpoint, and application teams to design, implement, and maintain enterprise security controls across hybrid IT environments. The role covers Identity and Access Management (IAM), Data Security, Cloud Security, Endpoint Security, and Network Security, with a focus on strengthening security posture, identifying risks, and implementing scalable security solutions.
q: Minimum 6 years of experience in Cloud Security, Cloud Infrastructure, Cybersecurity Operations, or a related field.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, cloud-native security tools, and identity management solutions.
Experience with endpoint security solutions (EDR/XDR), firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, SIEM, and log monitoring platforms.
Knowledge of encryption, key management, data protection, and vulnerability management tools.
Strong understanding of Zero Trust, Defense-in-Depth, Least Privilege, network segmentation, and incident response.
Familiarity with security frameworks and standards, including CIS Benchmarks, NIST, and ISO 27001.
Knowledge of Qatar National Information Assurance (NIA) requirements will be an added advantage.
Strong analytical, technical, documentation, and communication skills.
Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300).
CompTIA Security+, CySA+, ISC2 (CC/SSCP), CSA, or other relevant cloud security certifications.
r: li
Assess enterprise IT and cloud environments, identify security risks, and recommend appropriate security controls.
li
Implement and manage IAM controls, including RBAC, MFA, least privilege, PAM, and identity governance.
li
Implement data protection measures, including encryption, key management, data classification, and DLP.
li
Secure and monitor public, private, and hybrid cloud environments, including cloud configurations, workloads, network segmentation, and compliance.
li
Manage endpoint security solutions, including EDR/XDR, antivirus, device control, patch management, and security hardening.
li
Support the implementation and management of security technologies, SIEM platforms, and monitoring solutions.
li
Conduct security reviews, vulnerability assessments, and remediation activities.
li
Support security incident investigation and response.
li
Prepare and maintain security documentation, risk assessments, incident reports, and operational procedures.
li
Provide regular security posture updates to internal stakeholders and clients.
